direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; rows 48px header / 52px guide / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; cols 184px rail / minmax(0,1fr) stage / 360px inspector at 1366x768; stage at least 55vw and 60vh; no page scroll, internal scroll only in inspector and task lists; targets at least 36px; refit tight panels before shrinking type
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, silverDim rgba(197,204,212,.68), border rgba(197,204,212,.22); primary neon #A8F04A on #050705, one primary per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D reserved exclusively for stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text; official logo immutable black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story, never recolored, cropped, redrawn or duplicated elsewhere
direction.typography: System sans; 24/30 stage title, 15/20 panel title, 13/19 body, 11/14 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; enlarge stage labels under 11px to 11px minimum
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change, then static; no loops or pulses; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text still carry meaning; 2px neon focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries the second and final logo placement; step rail from one steps array with aria-current, arrow-key movement and 36-40px targets; guide strip 52px with no duplicate primary; focusable cinematic factory stage SVG; inspector 360px keeping pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity visually and semantically separate from the distinct investigation evidence task, with separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; skip-to-stage first, then header, rail, guide, SVG nodes, inspector and action bar in tab order; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite announces results only
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver for idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, never a route through the offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap; bidirectional SVG-to-inspector highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend using pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, while blocked prior tasks remain visible beside an approved recovery plan as replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Enlarge ev-cert-qty, ev-recv-qty and ev-sub-stock labels to 11px and link each to its inspector card with bidirectional highlight on hover, focus and tap.
Reduce the stacked opening headline height by 8px so the factory stage gains vertical room without scrolling at 1366x768.
Keep Route health pre-flight and Investigation source evidence as two separately headed, separately labelled controls; do not merge their status text or actions.
Add a visible 2px neon focus ring to the investigation route select and retain pointer style only while it is enabled.
Raise the dim sample-route helper text to silverDim contrast at 12px so the offline state is legible in the inspector.
Keep selecting a recovery option opening the typed consent form in place, with focus moved to the phrase field and the selected option named in its label.
Ensure the disabled Accept control shows no pointer style and expose its disabled reason beside the 0/27 typed counter.
Preserve the proposed tasks as deliberately untracked until approval; keep that dashed untracked treatment distinct from tracked task styling.
Remove the duplicate primary treatment: keep Approve in the action bar and make the inspector Approve a secondary duplicated-control-free reference, or vice versa.
Enlarge task pager targets 1, 2 and 3 to 40px with aria-labels naming each proposed task.
Make the CELL-MILL-2 preview unmistakably a preview with dashed silver outline and PREVIEW text, reserving solid stoppedRed for the actually stopped state in later steps.
Add focus ring and keyboard operability to the machine-to-take-offline select and announce the invalidation consequence via aria-live.
Keep stoppedRed confined to CELL-MILL-2 STOPPED, its cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text; check no red leaks to Receiving or constrained cards.
Preserve separate pre-flight route-health and investigation evidence sections exactly as in step 2, with the investigation action as the sole primary.
Clarify the constrained Split card with hatch plus CONSTRAINED text so meaning survives reduced motion and grayscale.
Keep the typed consent form directly tied to the selected revised option, with prior acceptance invalidated stated once in the action-bar status.
Ensure hatched constrained option is non-selectable, shows no pointer style, and is announced as unavailable with its reason.
Keep 3 blocked prior tasks visibly separate from the 3 proposed replacements awaiting approval beside the approved revised plan; do not merge counts or lists.
Give the blocked-tasks disclosure a 36px target, focus ring and expanded state, and size the inner scroll region so Approve and Decline stay visible at 768px height.
Remove duplicate primary emphasis between inspector Approve and the action-bar Approve revised tasks control.
Sequence Verify ledger, passphrase sealing and independent checkpoint as numbered steps with locked later controls clearly non-interactive and reason-labelled.
Fit the inspector by tightening spacing before reducing type so all three retain steps remain reachable by internal scroll with a visible scroll cue.
Keep the completion state in the action bar without adding a new primary; retain Back and Proof status with the sealed packet summary.
Add an explicit story-complete marker in the rail with aria-current on Recovery story complete and keep the header logo as one of only two logo placements.
